'''Xydge''' was a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] who worked as a security guard for the band [[Distraction]], along with his brothers [[Rydge]] and [[Stydge]]. When the band traveled to the ship ''[[Sleemo Poya Jeedai]]'' to perform at a concert, Xydge and his brothers accompanied them and met with some [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] who were providing additional security during the event. He and his brothers co-operated with them in investigating the threat posed to the event by [[Niklas Cories]] and Xydge escorted some doubles, who were posing as members of the band, off the ship in an attempt to confuse him.
